purpose: Final print/export contract for Black-Ink Bestiary interiors.

safe_layout.rule: Keep all essential monster anatomy, story props, and environment-defining forms comfortably inside the safe area. No artwork or linework should rely on trim-edge contact.

working_art.rule: Working generation may use lower resolution, but must preserve the final 8.5x11 portrait composition so export does not require destructive cropping.

page_content.rule: One primary monster is the dominant subject. Secondary creatures are allowed only when the scene requires them and they remain visually subordinate.
